lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Four distinct vertical columns of high-luminance circular spots are visible posterior to the gills, with each column containing approximately 3 to 5 primary centroids in a semi-regular grid arrangement.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity align with the columns of circular blobs, creating a grid-like lattice where the blobs serve as high-intensity anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear ridge is visible in the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient with high luminance on the superior edge and a deep shadow on the inferior edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A significant irregular V-shaped notch is visible on the posterior trailing edge of the pectoral fin, indicating localized tissue loss.
other_distinctive_markers: Two small, elongated silver-hued organisms (remoras) are present: one attached to the mid-lateral flank and one positioned near the trailing edge of the pectoral fin.
